_comment: Live-search PROBE SET 2 (post-test Phase 7): FRESH claims, drafted and committed BEFORE the verdict-path fix was implemented or run, because probe set 1 (live_probe.json) is used up -- a fix scored on the set that motivated it is tuned to it. Same styles and the same scoring and adoption rule as set 1 (scripts/live_probe.py). Deliberately includes 'tempting' false claims (wrong capitals, wrong firsts, wrong superlatives) like the three that failed in run 1. label: true | false | unverifiable. Our own wording; a demo set, not a benchmark. Labels await the project owner's approval before any run.
